items.summary: चीन ने सोने में खरीदारी फिर से बढ़ा दी है. सितंबर महीने के दौरान चीन ने 2023 के बाद सबसे ज्‍यादा मंथली गोल्‍ड खरीदारी की है. अब चीन का गोल्‍ड रिजर्व फ्रांस और इटली के काफी करीब पहुंच चुका है.

items.title: NCR में घरों की कीमतों में उछाल, 8 करोड़ से ऊपर के फ्लैट की सेल 36 गुना बढ़ी
items.summary: NCR में आवासीय संपत्तियों की बिक्री का कुल मूल्य 2023 के करीब 94,000 करोड़ रुपये से बढ़कर 2025 में 1.63 लाख करोड़ रुपये पहुंच गया.
items.normalised_title: ncr 8 36

items.title: दिल्ली पुलिस ने प्रदर्शनकारियों को दौड़ा-दौड़ाकर पकड़ा
items.summary: दिल्ली में 10 अक्टूबर को CJP के प्रदर्शन के दौरान पुलिस की कार्रवाई की कई तस्वीरें सामने आईं. कहीं प्रदर्शनकारियों को पकड़कर ले जाते पुलिसकर्मी दिखे, तो कहीं किसी को हाथ-पैर से उठाकर बस तक पहुंचाया गया. कुछ तस्वीरों में महिला प्रदर्शनकारियों को भी पुलिसकर्मी उठाकर ले जाते नजर आए.

items.title: तनुश्री का 'ईविल डेड' वाला बयान, याद आया नाना का पुराना जवाब
items.summary: तनुश्री दत्ता ने नाना पाटेकर के निधन के बाद जो बयान दिया, उसपर काफी चर्चा हुई. कई सालों से वो एक्टर पर सेक्शुअल हैरेसमेंट के आरोप लगाती आई हैं. लेकिन एक वक्त ऐसा भी था, जब नाना ने सामने से इस विवाद पर चुप्पी तोड़ी थी और तनुश्री के दावों को खारिज किया था.

items.title: मणिकर्णिका घाट पर दबंगों की गुंडागर्दी, 16 सेकंड का खौफनाक वीडियो
items.summary: वाराणसी के मणिकर्णिका घाट पर अंतिम संस्कार के दौरान विवाद के बाद एक युवक की बेरहमी से पिटाई का वीडियो सामने आया है. आरोप है कि डोम परिवार के कई युवकों ने उसे घेरकर पीटा और लकड़ी के बड़े लट्ठे से सिर पर वार किया.

items.title: ट्रंप के फैसले से गदगद हुआ लेबनान, 40 साल पुराना ये बैन हटाया
items.summary: लेबनान ने अमेरिका के उस फैसले का स्वागत किया है, जिसमें 1985 से बंद सीधी उड़ानों पर लगी पाबंदी हटा दी गई. राष्ट्रपति औन ने इसे नागरिक उड्डयन सुरक्षा में लेबनान के कदमों पर अमेरिकी भरोसे का संकेत बताया. दूसरी ओर, यमन के हूती विद्रोहियों के हमलों में रियाद एयरपोर्ट पर तीन विमान क्षतिग्रस्त हुए और तीन सऊदी नागरिक मारे गए.

items.title: 29KM माइलेज, धांसू लुक्स... क्या CRETA का खेल बिगाड़ेगी ये SUV
items.summary: रेनो डस्टर का नया अवतार आने वाला है. कंपनी इस कार के हाइब्रिड वर्जन को लॉन्च करने वाली है. अपकमिंग डस्टर हाइब्रिड को कंपनी 17 अक्टूबर को लॉन्च करेगी. ये कार माइलेज के मामले में अपने सेगमेंट में बेस्ट होने वाली है. कम से कम ऑन पेपर तो यही दिख रहा है.
items.normalised_title: 29km creta suv

items.title: 'CJP की प्रीति लोंढे को कोर्ट में करें पेश या घर भेजें', MP HC का आदेश
items.summary: MP High Court News: इटारसी रेलवे स्टेशन पर गोवा एक्सप्रेस से हिरासत में ली गई CJP कार्यकर्ता प्रीति लोंधे मामले में MP हाई कोर्ट सख्त. राज्य सरकार को मंगलवार तक महिला को कोर्ट में पेश करने या सुरक्षित घर भेजने के आदेश. पढ़ें पूरी रिपोर्ट...
items.normalised_title: cjp mp hc

items.title: Amitabh ने किया नाना को याद, शेयर किए पुराने वीडियो
items.summary: नाना पाटेकर के निधन से अमिताभ बच्चन भी गहरे दुख में हैं. अपने पुराने दोस्त को याद करते हुए अमिताभ ने इंस्टाग्राम पर कई पुराने वीडियो साझा किए, जिनमें दोनों की करीब 30 साल पुरानी दोस्ती की झलक दिखाई देती है. फिल्म ‘कोहराम’ के मुहूर्त से लेकर ‘कौन बनेगा करोड़पति’ में नाना की मौजूदगी तक, इन यादों ने प्रशंसकों को भावुक कर दिया. अपने ब्लॉग में अमिताभ ने लिखा कि अब नाना का संदेश नहीं आएगा.
items.normalised_title: amitabh

items.title: Nana Patekar मामले में तनुश्री को मिला इस सिंगर का साथ!
items.summary: नाना पाटेकर के निधन के बाद तनुश्री दत्ता के बयान को लेकर विवाद गहरा गया है. तनुश्री ने अभिनेता के निधन पर ‘ईविल इज डेड’ कहा था, जिसके बाद उन्हें सोशल मीडिया पर ट्रोल किया गया. अब गायिका चिन्मयी श्रीपदा उनके समर्थन में सामने आई हैं. उन्होंने कहा कि किसी की मौत उसे फरिश्ता नहीं बना देती. चिन्मयी ने तनुश्री के पुराने उत्पीड़न के आरोपों का जिक्र करते हुए सवाल उठाया कि उनसे चुप रहने या विनम्र बने रहने की उम्मीद क्यों की जा रही है.
items.normalised_title: nana patekar

items.title: Abhijeet Dipke और सहयोगियों की हिरासत पर बढ़ा विवाद
items.summary: कॉकरोच जनता पार्टी यानी सीजेपी ने अभिजीत दिपके, सौरव दास और आशुतोष रांका को लेकर गंभीर आरोप लगाए हैं. पार्टी का दावा है कि तीनों को हिरासत में लेकर अज्ञात जगहों पर रखा गया है. सीजेपी के मुताबिक, उनके परिवारों को न तो हिरासत की जानकारी दी गई और न ही ठिकाने का पता है. पार्टी ने यह भी आरोप लगाया कि तीनों को वकील से संपर्क करने की अनुमति नहीं मिल रही. इसी कार्रवाई पर सवाल उठाते हुए सीजेपी ने पूछा कि आपातकाल घोषित ही क्यों नहीं कर दिया जाता.
items.normalised_title: abhijeet dipke

items.title: अलवर में 250Kg का अजगर मिलने से गांव में मचा हड़कंप
items.summary: राजस्थान के अलवर जिले के ढढीकर गांव में करीब 15 फीट लंबा विशाल अजगर दिखाई देने से ग्रामीणों में हड़कंप मच गया. अजगर को देखने के लिए लोगों की भीड़ जुटी, तो कुछ लोग उसके साथ तस्वीर खिंचवाने लगे. सूचना मिलने पर बचाव दल मौके पर पहुंचा और पांच लोगों ने मिलकर अजगर को सुरक्षित पकड़ा. इसके बाद उसे सरिस्का के अंधेरी बफर जोन में छोड़ दिया गया. बचाव दल ने लोगों से वन्यजीवों से दूरी बनाए रखने की अपील की.
items.normalised_title: 250kg

items.title: CJP प्रमुख Abhijeet के परिवार में शोक, दादी का हुआ निधन
items.summary: कॉकरोच जनता पार्टी के संस्थापक अभिजीत दिपके की दादी सावित्रीबाई शंकर दिपके का शनिवार को लंबी बीमारी के बाद निधन हो गया. करीब 80 वर्ष की सावित्रीबाई ने महाराष्ट्र के हिंगोली जिले के संतुक पिंपरी गांव में अंतिम सांस ली. दिल्ली पुलिस ने हिरासत में मौजूद अभिजीत को इसकी जानकारी दी है. अब उनके सामने विकल्प है कि वह हिरासत में रहकर प्रदर्शन जारी रखें या दादी के अंतिम संस्कार में शामिल होने के लिए वापस लौटें.
items.normalised_title: cjp abhijeet

items.title: CJP प्रदर्शन और दिल्ली पुलिस की तैयारी पर दानिश का तंज
items.summary: दिल्ली के जंतर-मंतर पर 10 अक्टूबर को मतदाता सूची में कथित गड़बड़ियों के खिलाफ CJP के प्रस्तावित प्रदर्शन से पहले सुरक्षा कड़ी कर दी गई। इस बीच पाकिस्तान के पूर्व क्रिकेटर दानिश कनेरिया ने दिल्ली पुलिस की तैयारियों पर तंज कसा।
items.normalised_title: cjp

items.title: बल्लेबाजों के दबदबे से परेशान गंभीर, बोले- गेंदबाजों को भी मिले मौका
items.summary: भारतीय टीम ने कुछ द‍िन पहले गुवाहाटी में कमाल कर द‍िया था. वेस्ट इंडीज के खिलाफ वनडे मैच में 406 रनों का रिकॉर्ड लक्ष्य हासिल कर शुभमन गिल की अगुआई वाली टीम इंडिया ने हाहाकार मचा द‍िया था.

items.title: विमान से ही अभिजीत दिपके समेत दो अन्य नेता हिरासत में
items.summary: दिल्ली पुलिस ने कॉकरोच जनता पार्टी (CJP) के संस्थापक अभिजीत दिपके समेत सौरव दास और आशुतोष रांका को IGI एयरपोर्ट पर विमान के अंदर से हिरासत में लिया। पुलिस के विमान में पहुंचने पर नेताओं और जवानों के बीच बातचीत हुई।

items.title: नाना पाटेकर के निधन के बाद तनुश्री के बयान से मचा बवाल
items.summary: नाना पाटेकर के निधन के बाद बॉलीवुड एक्ट्रेस तनुश्री दत्ता लाइमलाइट में आ गई हैं. नाना की मौत के बाद तनुश्री ने उन्हें Evil Dead कहा. इसके बाद सोशल मीडिया पर उन्हें ट्रोल किया जाने लगा.

items.title: नाना पर आया था मनीषा का दिल फिर क्यों टूटा रिश्ता?
items.summary: बॉलीवुड के दिग्गज अभिनेता नाना पाटेकर अब इस दुनिया में नहीं, लेकिन नाना पाटेकर सिर्फ अपने किरदारों के लिए नहीं किए जाएंगे, बल्कि बॉलीवुड एक्ट्रेस संग उनके रिश्तों का भी जिक्र होता रहेगा. नाना पाटेकर और मनीषा कोइराला का रोमांटिक रिलेशनशिप किसी से छिपा नहीं है

items.title: नोबेल शांति पुरस्कार नहीं मिला तो नॉर्वे पर भड़के ट्रंप
items.summary: अमेरिकी राष्ट्रपति डोनाल्ड ट्रंप नोबेल शांति पुरस्कार नहीं मिलने से नाराज हैं। उन्होंने पुरस्कार के फैसले को शर्मनाक और अपमानजनक बताते हुए नॉर्वे की आलोचना की। ट्रंप ने पुरस्कार विजेता नवानेथेम नवी पिल्लै के चयन पर भी सवाल उठाए।

items.title: अखिलेश ने योगी को अयोध्या से चुनाव लड़ने की दी सलाह
items.summary: समाजवादी पार्टी प्रमुख अखिलेश यादव ने कहा कि केदारेश्वर धाम का निर्माण पूरा होने के बाद वह अयोध्या में राम मंदिर के दर्शन करेंगे। उन्होंने सनातन को सत्य और सेवा का रास्ता बताया और बीजेपी पर निशाना साधा।

items.title: ध्रुव राठी को गुरुग्राम में दिल्ली पुलिस ने हिरासत में लिया
items.summary: यूट्यूबर ध्रुव राठी को 10 अक्टूबर की सुबह गुरुग्राम में दिल्ली पुलिस ने हिरासत में लिया। पुलिस ने गुरुग्राम पुलिस के सहयोग से यह कार्रवाई की, हालांकि हिरासत की वजह अभी स्पष्ट नहीं है।

items.title: टीम इंडिया के खिलाफ वेस्टइंडीज ने रचा इतिहास
items.summary: रांची में खेले गए दूसरे टी20 इंटरनेशनल मुकाबले में वेस्टइंडीज ने भारतीय गेंदबाजों की जमकर धुनाई करते हुए 250 से अधिक रन का लक्ष्य हासिल कर इतिहास रच दिया.

items.title: स्टारलिंक को लेकर एलन मस्क ने अंबानी को घेरा
items.summary: एलन मस्क ने भारत में स्टारलिंक को मंजूरी मिलने में हो रही देरी को लेकर मुकेश अंबानी पर निशाना साधा है। मस्क ने लगातार दूसरे दिन सोशल मीडिया प्लेटफॉर्म X पर पोस्ट कर अंबानी पर भारत में एकाधिकार बनाए रखने और स्टारलिंक को प्रतिस्पर्धा का मौका नहीं देने का आरोप लगाया।

items.title: घर पर मसालों और ड्राई फ्रूट्स से बनाएं कश्मीरी शुफ्ता, आसान है रेसिपी

items.title: Canada to send 300-member trade delegation to India, largest in over 30 years
items.summary: Canada to send 300-member trade delegation to India, largest in over 30 years
items.body_text:
Canada to send 300-member trade delegation to India, largest in over 30 years
Ottawa, Canada will send nearly 300 business delegates to India next week on its largest trade mission to the country in over 30 years, seeking to expand commercial ties and "more than double bilateral trade" by 2030.
Led by Canadian Minister of International Trade Maninder Sidhu, the delegation will visit Mumbai and Bengaluru from October 12 to 17, according to an official statement on Friday.
"By matching Canadian expertise in sectors like aerospace, agri-food and clean technology with India's growing demand, we will diversify our trade and attract new investment," Sidhu said.
The mission comes as India and Canada are working to conclude negotiations for a Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement by the end of this year. The fifth round of negotiations was held in Ottawa from October 5 to 9.
Sidhu met Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal on the margins of the G20 Trade Ministers' Meeting in Milwaukee, US on October 1, where they discussed progress in the negotiations and efforts to deepen bilateral trade and investment ties.
The two countries announced the renewed push for a comprehensive trade agreement during Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney's visit to India in March, setting a target of raising two-way trade to CAD 70 billion by 2030.
In 2025, bilateral trade in goods and services totalled CAD 30.4 billion, according to the Canadian government data.
Canada's merchandise exports to India stood at CAD 3.9 billion in 2025, led by vegetables, mineral fuels and oils, and wood pulp. Its merchandise imports from India amounted to CAD 9.7 billion, comprising mainly precious stones and metals, machinery and pharmaceutical products.
The trade mission would help Canadian businesses connect with Indian decision-makers, industry leaders and potential customers, while building partnerships expected to generate employment in the North American country, according to Friday's statement.
Canada is also seeking to diversify its exports beyond the United States, with India forming a key part of its strategy to expand trade with other markets, the statement said.
The Canadian Indo-Pacific Strategy, launched in 2022, identifies trade, security, sustainability, people-to-people ties and regional engagement as its five strategic objectives, it said.

items.title: Putin conveyed Iran's view on resolving West Asia conflict to Trump, says Kremlin: Report
items.summary: Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said Putin conveyed Iran’s views to Trump in coordination with Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian.
items.body_text:
Putin conveyed Iran's view on resolving West Asia conflict to Trump, says Kremlin: Report
Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said Putin conveyed Iran’s views to Trump in coordination with Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian.
Russian President Vladimir Putin has conveyed Iran’s position on a possible resolution to the ongoing conflict in West Asia to US President Donald Trump, in coordination with Tehran, the Kremlin said, according to Al Arabiya, citing Russia’s Interfax news agency.
Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said Putin conveyed Iran’s views to Trump in coordination with Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian.
The Kremlin however did not disclose how Trump responded to Putin's message or provide further details about Iran's position on resolving the conflict.
Diplomatic efforts to end the Iran conflict, which has lasted more than seven months since US-Israeli strikes on Iran in February, have remained stalled since the summer.
Putin met Iranian Pezeshkian on the sidelines of a summit in Turkmenistan earlier this week, where the Russian leader expressed interest in helping broker peace.
In June, the United States and Iran agreed on a memorandum of understanding outlining a framework to end the conflict. However, Iranian attacks on ships in the Strait of Hormuz prompted the resumption of US military operations.
More recently, indirect talks between Washington and Tehran on the sidelines of the United Nations General Assembly failed to yield a breakthrough.
Trump spoke to Putin over Ukraine conflict
Separately, Trump shared his ideas on de-escalating the war in Ukraine with Putin during a phone call on Friday, the Kremlin said, according to AFP. Putin received the proposals “with understanding”, but Moscow did not elaborate on the measures suggested by Washington or the Russian president’s response.
Also Read | How Donald Trump made America’s government dumber
“The Russian president received with understanding certain proposals from the US side for measures aiming at de-escalation,” Peskov was quoted as saying on Saturday by Russian state news agencies TASS and RIA Novosti, AFP reported.
Trump, who took office in January 2025, has sought to broker an end to the war in Ukraine, which has continued for more than four and a half years. Talks between Moscow and Kyiv remain largely deadlocked, with both sides intensifying long-range strikes in recent months.
Meanwhile, US, Ukrainian and European officials met in Miami on Friday as Washington renewed diplomatic efforts to end the fighting and find a way out of the stalemate.
Also Read | Trump strikes major diesel deal with Russia in bid to lower US fuel prices ahead of midterms
Russian strikes kill 12 in Ukraine
Russian strikes killed at least 12 people, including three children, in Ukraine's Zaporizhzhia region, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said on Saturday. At least 14 people were wounded when Russian aerial bombs struck residential buildings in the region.
The attack came a day after US President Donald Trump announced a deal to buy Russian diesel, a move Kyiv warned could help fund Moscow's war in Ukraine. The announcement marked a reversal of years of US pressure on Russia over its invasion of Ukraine and came as Trump sought to address rising fuel prices ahead of the US midterm elections.
"Today, Russia expressed its thanks for the lifting of sanctions on diesel exports by dropping five glide bombs on residential buildings in Zaporizhzhia," Zelenskyy wrote on X on Saturday.
He said the attacks showed that Moscow interpreted "any easing of pressure to mean they can keep fighting, to mean they can keep dropping bombs on cities," adding that "different signals are needed."
(With inputs from AFP)

items.title: 'I should have won 8 Nobel Peace Prizes': Trump reiterates claim of brokering India-Pakistan truce
items.summary: Trump expressed anger over the Nobel Peace Prize being awarded to South African jurist Pillay, claiming that his record on peace efforts had been overlooked.
items.body_text:
'I should have won 8 Nobel Peace Prizes': Trump reiterates claim of brokering India-Pakistan truce
Trump expressed anger over the Nobel Peace Prize being awarded to South African jurist Pillay, claiming that his record on peace efforts had been overlooked.
US President Donald Trump has claimed that his role in settling the wars, including the India-Pakistan conflict, was enough to earn him the Nobel Peace Prize, arguing that he deserved the award for each of the eight conflicts he says he helped resolve.
In a lengthy post on Truth Social, Trump expressed anger over the Nobel Peace Prize being awarded to South African jurist Navi Pillay, claiming that his record on peace efforts had been overlooked despite his role in resolving several international conflicts.
“Any one of which, in particular, Pakistan and India, would be far more than necessary to win the Nobel Prize,” Trump wrote, referring to the eight conflicts he claimed to have settled.
Deep Dive
“In actuality, I should have won 8 Nobel Peace Prizes, not just 1,” he added.
Trump listed eight conflicts, including Cambodia and Thailand, Kosovo and Serbia, the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Rwanda, Pakistan and India, Israel and Iran, Egypt and Ethiopia, Armenia and Azerbaijan, and Israel and Hamas.
The US president also claimed that he had received letters from the presidents and prime ministers of countries involved in the conflicts, which he said had been sent to the Norwegian Nobel Committee in support of his nomination.
Trump further said he was working to settle two more conflicts, involving Iran and Russia's war against Ukraine, and claimed that both efforts were progressing “at breakneck speed”.
Trump questions Nobel Peace Prize decision
In his post, Trump criticised the decision to award the prize to a person he described as a liberal who works at the United Nations. He claimed that the recipient was largely unknown and alleged that she “very obviously, hates Israel”.
“I know nothing about this woman, and neither does anyone else!” Trump wrote, questioning what she had done to deserve the award.
He also criticised the United Nations, saying he had not relied on the organisation while working to settle the conflicts he listed.
“In all of the Wars that I have settled, I never spoke to the United Nations—they were of no help,” he said.
Trump argued that the United States, represented by him as president, should have received the award instead. He described the decision as “an indelible stain on Norway” and claimed it had permanently damaged the credibility of the Nobel Peace Prize.
Trump claims credit for other peace efforts
Beyond the eight conflicts, Trump claimed that he had prevented Iran from acquiring a nuclear weapon and stopped it from destroying Israel and threatening the wider Middle East and Europe.
He also said he had helped secure the return of Israeli hostages, including the final 28, both living and dead, and worked with Hamas to achieve their release.
Trump further claimed that he was preventing potential conflicts involving North Korea and South Korea, Japan and North Korea, as well as tensions between China and Taiwan.
He also credited himself with persuading NATO members to increase defence spending from 2% to 5% of their gross domestic product (GDP), saying the move had strengthened the alliance.
Additionally, Trump said he had helped secure the release of more than 900 political prisoners from several countries in Eastern Europe and brought 196 hostages home from captivity around the world without paying a ransom.
He concluded by reiterating that his record on peace deserved greater recognition, accusing those behind the Nobel Peace Prize decision of being “Radical Ideologues who are Anti-Democracy, and Enemies of Civilization”.

items.body_text:
The United States pressed Israel to carry out a solo strike operation against Iran during discussions between the two countries over the past two weeks, sources told Maariv in a report published on Saturday.
According to the report, Washington wanted Israel to assume the political risks of a military operation ahead of the US midterm elections, rather than US President Donald Trump.
American officials reportedly believed Israel would be interested in striking Iran before its own elections, while a US operation ahead of the midterms could have negative political consequences for Trump.
Previous reports have focused on Trump "considering" a resumption of military strikes against Iran, with additional reports emerging recently.
However, the latest information suggests that the initial American proposal effectively amounted to Trump directing Israel to strike Iran before the elections.
US backs down on demand for lone Israeli operation against Iran
The US has since backed down from its demand, at least for now, the sources told Maariv.
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's position on the matter remains unclear, the sources added.
Over the past week, Netanyahu's schedule was described as "very security-focused," and he held several "sensitive" meetings and visits.

items.title: Iran retains missile, drone production capabilities despite months of US-Israeli strikes - report
items.summary: Western intelligence assessments suggest Iran has preserved key weapons factories and can replenish its missile arsenal despite months of US-Israeli attacks.
items.body_text:
Iran has retained the ability to manufacture ballistic missiles and drones despite eight months of US and Israeli airstrikes, allowing Tehran to replenish its weapons stockpiles as US President Donald Trump debates delaying further military action until after the November midterm elections, Bloomberg reported on Friday, citing Western officials familiar with intelligence assessments.
The officials, who spoke on condition of anonymity, said Iran had preserved parts of its weapons manufacturing infrastructure despite extensive strikes targeting its military-industrial capabilities.
One Western official assessed that Tehran still possesses significant stocks of ballistic missiles and certain anti-ship weapons, with the capacity to manufacture additional munitions relatively quickly.
The official also claimed that Russia has been supplying Iran with missiles, consistent with a separate intelligence assessment from June. Russia's Defense Ministry did not respond to Bloomberg's request for comment.
The findings contrast with repeated assertions by Trump administration officials that the US-Israeli military campaign has effectively dismantled Iran's ability to threaten American military installations and regional allies.
Trump previously described Iran's military as "totally destroyed," while Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said on September 30 that US operations had destroyed Iran's "military industrial capacity" and "their entire defense base."
White House disputes assessment of Iran's military capabilities
White House spokesperson Anna Kelly rejected the Western officials' assessment, defending the effectiveness of American operations against Iran's nuclear and conventional military infrastructure.
“First, President Trump obliterated Iran’s nuclear facilities during Operation Midnight Hammer,” Kelly said in a statement.
“Then, Operation Epic Fury successfully destroyed the conventional shield that Iran sought to create over a nuclear program, including their ballistic missiles, production facilities, and navy.”
The extent of damage to Iran's missile industry has remained disputed. A September report, citing US and Middle Eastern officials, indicated that Tehran had resumed limited ballistic missile production using existing components, including at underground facilities, although manufacturing remained below prewar levels.
Trump announced on Thursday that the US would refrain from attacking Iran before the November midterm elections, after previously considering renewed military strikes amid escalating attacks on commercial shipping.
The pause could provide Tehran with additional time to restore production and replenish its arsenals, according to the Western assessments.
Iran has intensified attacks on vessels operating near the Strait of Hormuz, with at least 10 ships struck over the preceding week, according to the UK Navy.
The attacks have increased concerns about maritime security and potential disruption to global energy supplies, particularly as the US continues its naval blockade of Iranian oil exports.
In September, Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps warned that it could deploy different weapons and strike new targets if Washington launched another offensive, signaling its intention to maintain military pressure despite the damage sustained during the war.
Iran's remaining missile arsenal raises questions
The US-Israeli air campaign likely inflicted significant long-term damage on Iran's prewar missile production infrastructure, according to an assessment by Jim Lamson, a former CIA analyst and visiting research fellow at King's College London.
However, the precise size of Iran's remaining arsenal remains uncertain.
Israeli estimates placed Tehran's ballistic missile stockpile at approximately 2,500 before the war, while Western intelligence assessments in June suggested Iran still possessed roughly three-quarters of its prewar munitions.

items.title: Palestinian Authority President Abbas postpones November legislative elections until late 2027
items.summary: Israeli military attacks, settlement expansion, settler violence, restrictions on freedom of movement, and the withholding of Palestinian revenues were cited as reasons for the election postponement.
items.body_text:
Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas issued a decree on Saturday canceling legislative elections scheduled for November 28, 2026, and setting presidential and legislative elections for September 11, 2027, the official Palestinian news agency WAFA reported.
The new decree calls on Palestinians in Jerusalem, the West Bank, and the Gaza Strip to participate in "free and direct elections to elect the Palestinian president and members of the Palestinian Legislative Council simultaneously, in accordance with the law," WAFA said.
This follows consultations among Palestinian factions, political forces, and the Executive Committee of the Palestine Liberation Organization (PLO).
The Executive Committee reached a consensus, deciding that Israeli measures in the West Bank and Gaza posed a significant obstacle to holding elections at the previously scheduled date, WAFA explained, adding that the postponement is to allow for the establishment of "suitable political, security and field conditions for free, fair and inclusive elections."
WAFA cited Israeli military attacks, settlement expansion, settler violence, restrictions on freedom of movement, and the withholding of Palestinian revenues.
PA vice president reportedly informed France of election postponement
The WAFA report follows Palestinian Vice President Hussein Al Sheikh informing France of election postponements, citing worsening conditions across the Palestinian territories, according to a Thursday-dated letter addressed to French Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot seen by Reuters.
"The assessment concluded that the anticipated political, security and economic conditions, on which the scheduling of the legislative elections for November 28, 2026, was based, have not materialized," the letter said. "Holding them (the legislative elections) under the current circumstances faces fundamental obstacles affecting their inclusiveness, freedom of participation, and the integrity of the electoral process."

items.title: האיומים הבלתי פוסקים מטהרן - והדיווח המטריד: "איראן הצליחה לשקם את מפעלי הטילים"
items.summary: ב"בלומברג" דווח כי בניגוד גמור להצהרות נשיא ארה"ב, הרפובליקה האיסלאמית מצליחה לשקם את היכולות הצבאיות שלה בסיוע רוסיה - וכעת היא גם מסוגלת לייצר טילים במהירות. בינתיים טהרן ממשיכה לאיים מול המסרים מוושינגטון על האפשרות לחידוש האש, כשטראמפ עדיין מנסה להימנע מהסלמה לפני הבחירות
items.body_text:
איראן הצליחה לשקם את מפעלי הטילים והכטב"מים שלה, למרות חודשים של הפצצות מצד ארה"ב וישראל. כך דווח היום (שבת) ב"בלומברג" על סמך גורמים המעורים בנושא.
בסוכנות הידיעות דווח כי לדברי גורמים מערביים, שביקשו להישאר בעילום שם, טהרן עדיין מחזיקה ביכולת לייצר אמצעי לחימה ולשקם את מאגרי הנשק שלה. גורם אחד אף ציין כי איראן נותרה "מצוידת היטב" בטילים בליסטיים ובאמצעי לחימה מסוימים נגד ספינות, וכן כי היא מסוגלת לייצר טילים נוספים במהירות.
לדברי הגורם, רוסיה מספקת טילים לאיראן - דברים התואמים הערכות שפורסמו כבר במהלך חודש יוני האחרון. משרד ההגנה של רוסיה לא הגיב לבקשת "בלומברג" לתגובה. בדיווח צוין עוד כי שיקום מפעלי הטילים מאפשר לאיראן לחדש את מלאי הנשק שלה, בעוד נשיא ארה"ב דונלד טראמפ נמנע מתקיפות נוספות לקראת בחירות האמצע.
הערכה זו לגבי יכולות ייצור הטילים של איראן עומדת בסתירה לטענות חוזרות ונשנות מצד טראמפ ואנשיו, שלפיהן שמונה חודשים של תקיפות אוויריות חיסלו את היכולת של איראן לאיים על בסיסים אמריקניים באזור ועל בעלות בריתה של ארה"ב. מוקדם יותר השנה אמר טראמפ כי הצבא האיראני "הושמד לחלוטין", ובנאום שנשא ב-30 בספטמבר אמר שר ההגנה פיט הגסת' כי ארה"ב השמידה את "היכולת הצבאית-תעשייתית" של איראן ואת "כל התשתית הביטחונית שלה".
על פי הדיווח האחרון, היכולת הזו של איראן מגבירה את הסבירות שהיא תוכל לשקם את מערך הטילים שלה אם טראמפ יממש את הבטחתו – שפורסמה ברשתות החברתיות ביום חמישי, שלא לתקוף את הרפובליקה האיסלאמית לפני בחירות האמצע בנובמבר. 
כמו כן, צוין בדיווח כי טהרן הגבירה את התקיפות נגד כלי שיט באזור מצר הורמוז, ועל פי הצי הבריטי, היא פגעה ב-10 כלי שיט לפחות במהלך השבוע האחרון.
בתגובתה לדיווח ב"בלומברג", דחתה דוברת הבית הלבן את הפרטים. לדבריה, "הנשיא טראמפ החריב כליל את מתקני הגרעין של איראן במהלך מבצע 'פטיש חצות'. לאחר מכן במהלך מבצע 'זעם אפי'  השמיד בהצלחה את המגן הקונבנציונלי שאיראן ביקשה ליצור סביב תוכנית הגרעין שלה - לרבות הטילים הבליסטיים, מתקני הייצור והצי הימי שלה". 
נזכיר שה"ניו יורק טיימס" דיווח שלשום כי צבא ארה"ב נערך לחידוש מתקפה נרחבת נגד איראן, ובפנטגון גיבשו תוכניות למבצע צבאי אינטנסיבי שיימשך כשלושה ימים בלבד. לפי הדיווח, על אף ההיערכות הצבאית הנרחבת וההסלמה בתקיפות האיראניות נגד מכליות נפט, הנשיא דונלד טראמפ ממשיך להסס אם לחדש את הלחימה בהיקף משמעותי - ובחודשים האחרונים אף דחה חמש הצעות שונות לפעולות צבאיות גדולות נגד איראן או החות'ים בתימן.
לפי הדיווח, טראמפ הורה פעם נוספת להכין אפשרויות תקיפה, וביום שישי שעבר דנו בכירי הממשל בתוכניות בפגישה שנערכה בקמפ דייוויד, בהובלת סגן הנשיא ג'יי די ואנס. במוקד הדיונים עמדה תוכנית למבצע קצר ועוצמתי, שיימשך כשלושה ימים ויתמקד במערכי הטילים והכטב"מים של איראן, שחלקים נרחבים מהם שוקמו על ידי משמרות המהפכה מאז השלבים הראשונים של המלחמה. בין היעדים הנוספים שנשקלים נמצאים מתקני אנרגיה, מפקדות ומרכזי פיקוד של משמרות המהפכה.
"ערוכים למו"מ ולא חוששים ממנו"
בינתיים עתיד הגזרה האיראנית עדיין נמצא תחת סימן שאלה אחד גדול, כשהתקדמות במשא ומתן בין איראן לארה"ב עדיין אין, המאבקים על הורמוז נמשכים, הסכמה על פתרון סוגיית הגרעין לא נראית באופק והכוחות האיראנים ממשיכים לאיים, מול טענותיהם של האמריקנים להישגים. כל זאת, כשבשבועות הקרובים ישראל וארה"ב הולכות לבחירות, מה שמעורר שאלות גם בצד האיראני לגבי השפעות השיקולים הפוליטיים על ההחלטות המבצעיות. 
שר החוץ האיראני עבאס עראקצ'י הודיע שלשום כי "תהליך המשא ומתן נמשך ומסרים מועברים באמצעות מתווכים. הצגנו את ההצעה שלנו, של תוכנית שבעת הימים, ושמענו את עמדת הצד האמריקני בנוגע אליה. אנחנו בוחנים כעת את העמדה האמריקנית, ולהערכתי נמסור את תשובתנו בימים הקרובים". גם דובר משרד החוץ האיראני, איסמאעיל בקאי, מסר בימים האחרונים כי "הובהרו תנאיה של איראן לסיום המלחמה בכל החזיתות ושיקום הביטחון במפרץ הפרסי ומצר הורמוז" וכן כי "מסרים מוחלפים בין איראן לארה"ב באמצעות מתווכים". 
למרות ההתבטאויות האיראניות, את תוכנית "שבעת הימים" שהוצגה בספטמבר, טראמפ כבר דחה. התוכנית כללה, לפי הדיווחים, את עצירת הפעולות העוינות באזור למשך שבוע, כולל בלבנון, שחרור 12 מיליארד דולר מהנכסים המוקפאים האיראניים, הסרת הסנקציות על ייצוא הנפט האיראני, הסרת המצור האמריקני על הנמלים האיראניים, ערבויות הקשורות לכיבוד הריבונות האיראנית, מחויבות למזכר ההבנות בין איראן לארה"ב ועצירת האיומים נגד איראן.
ביום השביעי, לפי ההצעה, איראן תפתח את מצר הורמוז, אם ימולאו תנאיה. מבחינת האיראנים, אלה עדיין הדרישות. דוברת

items.title: מספר 2 של סמוטריץ': הכי הייתי רוצה לסגור את משרד החינוך
items.summary: יו"ר מפלגת זהות, משה פייגלין, אמר כי היה סוגר שני שלישים ממשרדי הממשלה - ובראשם משרד החינוך, אותו כינה "משרד הפרוגרס". בנוסף הביע רצון לסגור את משרד התרבות - ולהפסיק לממן ישיבות: "לא צריך לממן לימודי תורה, וגם לא את הישיבה הפגאנית שמכונה המחלקה ללימודי מגדר באוניברסיטת ת"א"
items.body_text:
יו"ר מפלגת זהות משה פייגלין, מספר 2 ברשימה המאוחדת עם "הציונות הדתית" של בצלאל סמוטריץ', אמר כי היה סוגר את משרד החינוך. "הכי הייתי רוצה לסגור את משרד החינוך. זה משרד האנטי-חינוך. משרד הבורות, השחיתות, הפרוגרס. כל שם אני יכול לקרוא לו חוץ מחינוך", אמר השבוע בפודקאסט "הכל פתוח" עם איש התקשורת אבי שושן.
פייגלין, שלפי כל הסקרים האחרונים צפוי לחזור לכנסת אחרי למעלה מעשור,  ציין כי היה סוגר שני שלישים ממשרדי הממשלה - בראשם משרד החינוך. המפד"ל, שמפלגת "הציונות הדתית" מתיימרת להמשיך את דרכה, נהגה באופן מסורתי לדרוש את תיק החינוך וראתה בו נכס אסטרטגי. 
בנוסף ציין פייגלין כי היה סוגר את משרדי התרבות, איכות הסביבה, חקלאות וכלכלה. הוא ציין כי בממשלתו של דוד בן גוריון היו רק שמונה משרדי ממשלה, והוא כיום היה רוצה להמשיך להפעיל 11 משרדים בלבד. "שליש מהכנסת זה חברי ממשלה. איפה נשמע כדבר הזה?!".
גם את הרצון שלו לסגור את משרד התרבות והספורט הוא ניסה להסביר: "המשרד הזה לא קיים מבחינתי. תמיכה בתרבות - לא קיים. יש לך סרט שנורא חשוב לך? או שהוא יהיה מסחרי ויממן את עצמו או שתמצא איזה פילנתרופ". לדבריו, אין סיבה לממן את הבימה, הקאמרי ועוד. "המדינה לא צריכה להתערב בתרבות או בלימודים. לא תורניים אגב, ולא במדעי הרוח באוניברסיטאות", הוסיף.
לכן, גם בישיבות לתפיסתו אין צורך לתמוך "בשביל התורה". "זה כדי שהתורה תהיה עצמאית. באמריקה יש תלמידי חכמים לא קטנים, אין שום תמיכה של האמריקנים, של המדינה. תהיה תורה אמיתית שלא תהיה תלויה בממשלה ובאג׳נדה. זה יעשה טוב ללימוד התורה. למה אני צריך לממן את הישיבה האידאולוגית הפגאנית שמכונה המחלקה ללימודי מגדר באוניברסיטת תל אביב. ומצד שני - לא צריך לממן לימודי תורה".
בתחילת החודש שעבר הגיעו סמוטריץ' ופייגלין לסיכום על ריצה משותפת בבחירות הקרובות, כדי לנסות ולצלוח את אחוז החסימה. מאז בכל הסקרים הם עוברים את אחוז החסימה ועומדים על בין חמישה לשמונה מנדטים. לפי הסיכום בין השניים, פייגלין קיבל את המקום השני ברשימה המשותפת לכנסת, וגם את מקומות 8, 10 ו-11.
הצדדים סיכמו שהחיבור ביניהם יהיה "טכני" בלבד, כך שהקמפיין מנוהל בנפרד, כמו גם שלטי הבחירות הפרוסים ברחבי הארץ - ואחרי הבחירות הם יתפצלו וינהלו את המו"מ הקואליציוני בנפרד, ככל שיהיה כזה.

items.title: אפילו טקסס וקנזס על סף מהפך: כל הסימנים ל"צונאמי כחול" נגד טראמפ
items.summary: טקסס לא שלחה דמוקרט לסנאט 38 שנה, אך הנוצרי-פרוגרסיבי טלריקו מוביל בה. בקנזס זה לא קרה כמעט 100 שנה, וגם שם הקרב צמוד. פחות מחודש לפני בחירות האמצע בארה"ב, גוברת ההערכה שהדמוקרטים ינצחו גם במעוזים שמרניים ויכבשו את הקונגרס. טראמפ הקים "חומה" עם שינוי מפת מחוזות הבחירה, אבל המלחמה באיראן, יוקר המחיה ו"הבגידה" בהיספנים הם מתכון לגל אדיר: "זה יהיה מרחץ דמים, קדימון ל-2028". איך זה ישפיע על ישראל, ואולי הסקרים שוב טועים בגדול?
items.body_text:
כאשר נשיאי ארצות הברית נכנסים לבית הלבן, הם יודעים שהקדנציה האמיתית שלהם, זו שבה הם יכולים לשנות מדיניות פנים באופן שישפיע לדורות קדימה, תימשך שנתיים, ולא ארבע שנים. זהו "חלון ההזדמנויות של השנתיים הראשונות" (The Two-Year Window), הזמן שבו חייב נשיא להעביר את הרפורמות הכי גדולות, שנויות במחלוקת ומשמעותיות שלו – מפני שאחר כך מגיעות בחירות אמצע הכהונה, והמפלגה שלו, בוודאות גדולה, תאבד את הרוב שיש לה בקונגרס.
הפעם האחרונה שבה מפלגתו של נשיא מכהן כן הצליחה לשמור על הרוב בשני בתי הקונגרס בבחירות האמצע הייתה בנסיבות יוצאות דופן: זה קרה ב-2002, שנה אחרי פיגועי 11 בספטמבר, כשג'ורג' בוש הבן עדיין נהנה מאחוזי תמיכה גבוהים מאוד והמפלגה הרפובליקנית לא רק שמרה על כוחה, אלא אף הגדילה אותו. ב-1998 הגדילו הדמוקרטים את כוחם בקונגרס דווקא בשיא פרשת מוניקה לווינסקי שבה הסתבך ביל קלינטון, שנותר פופולרי בזכות מצב כלכלי מעולה; והפעם היחידה הנוספת שבה זה קרה בעידן המודרני הייתה ב-1934, כשפרנקלין רוזוולט הוציא את ארה"ב מהשפל הגדול. בכל שאר המקרים, ובאופן היסטורי בבחירות האמצע – שנתפסות כמשאל עם על תפקודו של הנשיא – מפלגתו "חוטפת בראש". 
כל הסימנים מראים כי בחירות האמצע בחודש הבא לא יהיו שונות מהבחינה הזו, והשאלה המסתמנת היא האם יקרה לדונלד טראמפ מה שקרה לג'ו ביידן ב-2022 – אז היו תחזיות ל"צונאמי" לטובת הרפובליקנים, אבל הדמוקרטים שמרו בסופו של דבר על השליטה בסנאט והפסידו את בית הנבחרים רק בפער קטנטן – או שהתחזיות הנוכחיות, שמבטיחות כעת "גל כחול" לטובת הדמוקרטים, אכן יתממשו. 
ניצחון דמוקרטי גדול ייתפס כמכה קשה עבור טראמפ, שכבר נראה כמי שנערך להצדיק את ההפסד בטענה שהוא משמיע בשבועות האחרונים ולפיה הסיבה לסקרים הבעייתיים עבור הרפובליקנים היא שהוא עצמו לא מתמודד ולא מופיע על פתקי ההצבעה. אבל בפועל הסקרים מעידים על תסכול אדיר של הציבור האמריקני – גם בקרב רפובליקנים רבים ובמיוחד עצמאים שלא מזדהים עם מי מהמפלגות הגדולות – בעקבות המלחמה הלא-פופולרית באיראן, והזינוק במחירי הדלק ויוקר המחיה שהיא חוללה. התמיכה בטראמפ נמצאת כעת בשפל, ואפילו במעוזים "אדומים" כמו פלורידה מועמדים רפובליקנים מתרחקים ממנו וקוראים לסיום מהיר של המלחמה, מחשש שהנשיא הלא-פופולרי יגרור אותם מטה ויביא לתבוסתם.
מה בוחרים  
בבחירות האמצע שייערכו ב-3 בנובמבר – שבוע בדיוק אחרי הבחירות בישראל – יועמדו לבחירה כל 435 מושבי בית הנבחרים ו-35 מ-100 מושבי הסנאט. במקביל נערכים מרוצים ל-39 מושלי מדינות וטריטוריות אמריקניות, ולאלפי מושבים בבתי הקונגרס המקומיים במדינות השונות. הרפובליקנים שולטים כיום בשני בתי הקונגרס בוושינגטון: היתרון שלהם בסנאט משמעותי יחסית (47-53) ובבית הנבחרים הוא נחשב לזעום (214-218, לצד עצמאי אחד שנוטה לצד הרפובליקני ושני מושבים פנויים בעקבות התפטרויות). בבית הנבחרים דרוש רוב של 218 לפחות, בעוד בסנאט זקוקים הדמוקרטים לרוב של 51 קולות לפחות כדי לשלוט בו. במקרה של תיקו 50-50 – הרפובליקנים ישמרו על השליטה בסנאט, מפני שהקול שובר השוויון יהיה שמור לסגן הנשיא ג'יי די ואנס.
השליטה הרפובליקנית בבית הנבחרים אמורה הייתה בכל מקרה ליפול קורבן ל"קללת" בחירות האמצע, אבל הסנאט, שם רק שליש מהמושבים מועמדים לבחירה מדי שנתיים, לא היה צפוי להיות תחרותי כלל. מפת הבחירות לסנאט בסיבוב הזה נחשבה, בתחילת מחזור הבחירות, לקשה מאוד עבור הדמוקרטים – כשהיא כוללת לא רק הגנה על מושבים שבהם הם מחזיקים כעת במדינות מתנדנדות כמו מישיגן וג'ורג'יה, אלא גם קרבות שאמורים היו להיות חסרי סיכוי במעוזים שמרניים כמו טקסס, אוהיו, אייווה, אלסקה וקנזס. 
אבל שלושה שבועות לפני הבחירות, נראה שהמאבק על השליטה בסנאט פתוח לחלוטין – וכעת גם סוכנויות ההימורים וגם הפרשנים הפוליטיים נותנים לדמוקרטים סיכוי גבוה יחסית להשתלט על שני בתי הקונגרס. הסיבה לכך היא כמעט לגמרי המצב הכלכלי: חוץ מהעשירים ביותר שהתעשרו עוד יותר, מצבו של אף אמריקני לא השתפר בשנתיים האחרונות. גם תומכיו הנאמנים ביותר של טראמפ לא יכולים לספר לעצמם שהכול בסדר, כשהם עומדים בתחנות דלק ורואים את המספרים רצים על המשאבה. 
מה אומרים הסקרים
עידן טראמפ הוא סיוט מתמשך גם עבור טובי הסוקרים בארה"ב. בבחירות 2016 הם התרסקו לגמרי, והבינו כי הם צריכים לבנות מודלים חדשים לגמרי כדי לסקור מפת מצביעים שכוללת מצביעים חדשים באזורים מאוד מרוחקים, מצביעים שלא עונים לטלפונים, מצביעים שלא אומרים את האמת לסוקרים, ושינויים גדולים בדפוסי ההצבעה של צעירים ומיעוטים. מאז 2016 הסוקרים השתפרו במעט, אבל רק במעט.

items.title: Trump takes Clinton lawsuit to Supreme Court after $1M sanctions
items.summary: President Donald Trump asked the U.S. Supreme Court on Friday to revive his dismissed lawsuit accusing his 2016 Democratic rival Hillary Clinton, former FBI Director James Comey an...
items.body_text:
© Turkuvaz Haberleşme ve Yayıncılık 2026
                        
													
								Edited By Kelvin Ndunga
							
						                    
            				
									by Reuters
								
            			Oct 10, 2026 2:04 pm
        
President Donald Trump asked the U.S. Supreme Court on Friday to revive his dismissed lawsuit accusing his 2016 Democratic rival Hillary Clinton, former FBI Director James Comey and others of conspiring to undermine his campaign by linking it to Russia.
Trump filed the appeal after a federal judge dismissed the lawsuit and ordered him and one of his lawyers to pay nearly $1 million in sanctions for bringing what the court described as a “frivolous” case. A federal appeals court later upheld both the dismissal and the sanctions.
Trump filed the lawsuit in 2022, after leaving office following his 2020 election defeat. The lengthy complaint, filed in federal court in Florida, named Clinton, Comey, former British intelligence officer Christopher Steele, the Democratic National Committee and numerous other defendants.
Trump, who has repeatedly pursued legal action against political opponents, alleged that Clinton and her allies conspired before the 2016 election to discredit him by promoting what he called a “false narrative” that his campaign had colluded with Russia.
The lawsuit included claims of racketeering and conspiracy to commit injurious falsehood, among other allegations.
Trump defeated Clinton in the 2016 election despite losing the national popular vote. He served his first term as president from 2017 to 2021.
U.S. government officials have accused Russia of interfering in the 2016 election. An investigation led by former FBI Director Robert Mueller documented extensive contacts between the Trump campaign and Russian operatives who sought to influence the election in Trump's favor. Trump has dismissed allegations of Russian interference as a “hoax.”
Since losing to Democrat Joe Biden in 2020, Trump has repeatedly made false claims of widespread voting fraud in that election. He regained the presidency by defeating Democrat Kamala Harris in 2024 and has continued to make those claims.
U.S. District Judge Donald Middlebrooks dismissed Trump's lawsuit against Clinton, citing numerous deficiencies, including that Trump had waited too long to bring some of his claims. The judge likened the lawsuit to a “two-hundred-page political manifesto outlining his grievances against those that have opposed him.”
Middlebrooks later ordered Trump and his lead attorney in the case, Alina Habba, to pay nearly $1 million in fees and costs. He imposed the sanctions for bringing a lawsuit that he said was intended “to dishonestly advance a political narrative.” The judge also criticized Trump and his lawyers for a “continuing pattern of misuse of the courts.”
Middlebrooks found that the lawsuit relied on abusive litigation tactics, contained “knowingly false” factual allegations and advanced “frivolous” legal theories.
The Atlanta-based 11th U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals upheld the judge's rulings in 2025, including the sanctions.
“Many of Trump's and Habba's legal arguments were indeed frivolous,” the 11th Circuit said.
In court filings, lawyers for Trump and Habba argued that the lower courts' decisions were having a “profound impact on the presidency, and the nation as a whole.”
Mueller, who was appointed special counsel by the Justice Department, issued a report in 2019 detailing his investigation. The report concluded that Russia “interfered in the 2016 presidential election in sweeping and systematic fashion,” but said the investigation “did not establish that members of the Trump campaign conspired or coordinated with the Russian government in its election interference activities.”
Mueller also reported finding “numerous links” between the Trump campaign and Russia, adding that the campaign “expected it would benefit” from Moscow's efforts to influence the election in Trump's favor.

items.title: Indonesia’s raging wildfires endanger orangutans, scorch forests
items.summary: Wildfires raging across parts of Indonesia’s Borneo island are threatening endangered orangutans, forcing rescuers to evacuate animals found injured, stranded or struggling to surv...
items.body_text:
© Turkuvaz Haberleşme ve Yayıncılık 2026
                        
													
								Edited By Kelvin Ndunga
							
						                    
            				
									by Associated Press
								
            			Oct 10, 2026 2:00 pm
        
Wildfires raging across parts of Indonesia’s Borneo island are threatening endangered orangutans, forcing rescuers to evacuate animals found injured, stranded or struggling to survive amid thick smoke and scorched forests.
Among dozens of orangutans rescued from fires across Sumatra and Borneo in recent months was a female Bornean orangutan known as Novita.
Rescuers found her clinging to a nearly leafless tree as dense smoke engulfed the charred landscape of the Katune forest in Central Kalimantan province, said Jamartin Sihite, chairman of the Borneo Orangutan Survival Foundation.
“The palms of her hands and the soles of her feet suffered burns that were likely sustained when Novita crossed a burned area while trying to reach a tree,” Sihite told The Associated Press in an interview. He said Novita, estimated to be 3 to 4 years old, was tranquilized, given oxygen and intravenous fluids, and taken to the rehabilitation center in Nyaru Menteng.
Once her burns have healed, Novita will be evaluated to determine whether she can climb and survive in her natural environment, Sihite said.
“We have previously released orangutans missing several fingers, and they were still able to survive in the forest, so we remain hopeful that Novita can eventually return to the wild.”
Forest and land fires in Indonesia have worsened this year as El Niño intensifies a prolonged dry season, affecting not only the Indonesian part of Borneo but also some regions of Sumatra. Water shortages in affected areas have hampered firefighting efforts, while Japan has provided firefighting assistance on the island.
A male orangutan named Sampurna, believed to be around 20 years old, was found struggling to breathe by residents early last month on a palm oil plantation in West Kalimantan’s Ketapang district, an area affected by wildfires. He died hours after being rescued, Indonesia’s Forestry Ministry said.
More than 270 wild animals in Kalimantan had been rescued, rehabilitated or guided to safer habitats as of Saturday, the ministry said.
Government data showed that more than 202,000 hectares (499,000 acres) of land burned between January and July. The independent Nusantara Atlas project, which monitors fires using satellite imagery, estimated that nearly 896,000 hectares (2.2 million acres) had burned by the end of August.
Toxic haze and smoke have also caused a health crisis in neighboring countries. The smoke has drifted as far as the Philippines, more than 800 kilometers (500 miles) away. In Malaysia, authorities declared an emergency last week in Sarawak, on the Malaysian part of Borneo.
Novita’s case highlights the impact of forest and peatland fires on wildlife as well as people, said Andi Muhammad Kadhafi, head of the Central Kalimantan Natural Resources Conservation Agency, a government body.
“Wildfires do not only affect humans but can also threaten wildlife and their habitats,” he said. “Fire prevention, habitat protection, monitoring and rapid response need to go hand in hand.”

items.summary: A team of U.S.-based marine archaeologists has set sail for a remote island in the western Pacific in hopes of uncovering new evidence in one of the 20th century’s most enduring my...

								Edited By Kelvin Ndunga
							
						                    
            				
									by Reuters

A team of U.S.-based marine archaeologists has set sail for a remote island in the western Pacific in hopes of uncovering new evidence in one of the 20th century’s most enduring mysteries: the 1937 disappearance of famed aviator Amelia Earhart.
Supported by Purdue University, which has long been associated with Earhart and her legacy, the team aims to determine whether an object detected beneath the waters of the island’s lagoon in satellite imagery six years ago is the wreckage of her twin-engine Lockheed Electra 10-E aircraft.
If confirmed, the discovery would lend decisive support to a longstanding theory that Earhart and her navigator, Fred Noonan, crash-landed on or near the coral-ringed atoll and died as castaways, hundreds of miles from their intended refueling stop.
The expedition departed Los Angeles earlier this month and was expected to reach Nikumaroro on Tuesday, Oct. 13, local time. The uninhabited island lies in the remote Phoenix Islands, part of the Pacific nation of Kiribati.
“Finding Amelia Earhart’s Electra aircraft would be the discovery of a lifetime,” Richard Pettigrew, head of the Archaeological Legacy Institute in Eugene, Oregon, who is leading the effort in conjunction with Purdue, said in press materials for the mission.
Purdue general counsel and expedition member Steve Schultz, who was in Fiji conducting advance work for the expedition last week, said in an interview: “This would be solving one of the great mysteries in aviation history, certainly one of the great mysteries of the 20th century.”
The mission has its skeptics. Chief among them is rival Earhart explorer Ric Gillespie, co-founder of TIGHAR, short for The International Group for Historic Aircraft Recovery, and author of the 2024 book “One More Good Flight: The Amelia Earhart Tragedy.”
Gillespie has led a dozen expeditions of his own to the atoll over three decades and is the leading proponent of the Nikumaroro castaway theory. But he predicted the Pettigrew-Purdue team would find no airplane wreckage or anything else of consequence left on the island.
The Purdue team credits Gillespie with laying the foundation for the theory it hopes to prove. It also cites a compelling body of evidence he has amassed over the years, including human artifacts recovered on the island, such as a 1930s-era glass cosmetic jar for freckle cream and remnants of a jackknife like one Earhart carried on the plane.
Gillespie’s investigation also encompassed modern forensic analysis of records documenting measurements of skeletal remains found on the island in the 1940s; logs of radio transmission bearings from distress calls picked up by wireless operators in the days immediately after Earhart vanished; and a photograph taken of the island’s shoreline months later showing an object that Gillespie said appears to be the Electra’s landing gear.
In a Reuters interview last week, Gillespie said he believes the plane has since been lost to history, eventually swept by tides off the coral flat where it had landed largely intact and carried into the sea, where it sank and broke apart in the surf.
Two previous attempts to locate the plane’s wreckage in the surrounding ocean, including a 2019 operation conducted by marine archaeologist Robert Ballard, known for discovering the wreck of the Titanic, proved fruitless, Gillespie said.
A plane-shaped sonar image from elsewhere on the seafloor turned out to be a pile of rocks.
“I’d love to find that airplane. It ain’t gonna happen,” Gillespie said.

items.title: Eyüpsultan Belediyesi'nde Başkan Vekili seçimi başladı
items.summary: Tutuklanıp görevden uzaklaştırılan Eyüpsultan Belediye Başkanı Mithat Bülent Özmen’in yerine gelecek başkan vekilinin belirlenmesi için belediye meclisinde seçim başladı. İlk turda CHP'nin adayı 21, AK Partinin adayı ise 15 oy aldı.
items.body_text:
Derya EVREN KORKMAZ / İSTANBUL, (DHA)
Oluşturulma Tarihi: Ekim 10, 2026 15:46
Tutuklanıp görevden uzaklaştırılan Eyüpsultan Belediye Başkanı Mithat Bülent Özmen’in yerine gelecek başkan vekilinin belirlenmesi için belediye meclisinde seçim başladı. İlk turda CHP'nin adayı 21, AK Partinin adayı ise 15 oy aldı.
Haberlerimizi Google’da Takip Edin
Gelişmelerden anında haberdar olun.
Ankara Cumhuriyet Başsavcılığınca yürütülen soruşturma kapsamında Eyüpsultan Belediye Başkanı Mithat Bülent Özmen tutuklanıp görevden uzaklaştırıldı. Mithat Bülent Özmen’in tutuklanmasının ardından başkan vekilinin belirlenmesi için belediye meclisi saat 14.00'te toplandı. Seçimde 37 meclis üyesinin oy kullanacağı öğrenildi.
Eyüpsultan Belediye Meclisi’nde CHP’nin 23, Cumhur İttifakı’nın ise 14 üyesi bulunuyor. CHP’nin adayı Cafer Parlak ile AK Parti’nin adayı Muhammet Çakır’ın yarışacağı seçimde, yapılacak oylamanın ardından yeni başkan vekili belli olacak. Seçimin yapılacağı salona yalnızca belediye meclis üyeleri alınırken, bina çevresinde geniş güvenlik önlemleri alındı.
İLK TUR TAMAMLANDI
İlk tur sayım sonuçlarına göre CHP'nin adayı 21, AK Partinin adayı ise 15 oy aldı. Oylamada 1 oy geçersiz sayıldı.
items.normalised_title: eyüpsultan belediyesinde başkan vekili seçimi başladı

Fatih YILMAZ/ZİLE (Tokat), (DHA)
Oluşturulma Tarihi: Ekim 10, 2026 15:39
Tokat'ın Zile ilçesinde 22 yaşındaki B.G., arkadaşı Enes Ertaş'ı tüfekle vurarak öldürdü. Olayın ardından B.G. polisi arayarak kendini ihbar etti.
Haberlerimizi Google’da Takip Edin

Olay, saat 02.00 sıralarında Zile ilçesi Bahçelievler Mahallesi Akif Bey Sokak’ta meydana geldi. İddiaya göre, B.G. ve arkadaşı Enes Ertaş, arasında henüz bilinmeyen nedenle tartışma çıktı. Tartışmanın büyümesi sonucu B.G. yanında getirdiği tüfekle Ertaş'a ateş etti. Vücudunun çeşitli yerlerine saçmaların isabet ettiği Ertaş, hayatını kaybetti.
Olayın ardından B.G., polisi arayarak arkadaşını vurduğunu bildirdi. Adrese giden polis ekipleri B.G.'yi gözaltına aldı. Sağlık ekipleri de Enes Ertaş'ın cenazesini Zile Devlet Hastanesi morguna kaldırdı.
Olayla ilgili soruşturma başlatıldı.

items.title: Trabzon'daki kadın cinayetinde yeni detaylar! 14 gün önce katilinin hayatını kurtarmış
items.summary: Trabzon'un Arsin ilçesinde 33 yaşındaki Gülşah Oktay'ın, 51 yaşındaki eski eşi Aydın Yediparmak tarafından sokak ortasında 7 kurşunla vurularak öldürüldüğü olaya ilişkin yeni detaylar ortaya çıktı. Gülşah Oktay'ın, olaydan 14 gün önce ilaç içerek intihar girişiminde bulunan Aydın Yediparmak’ın hayatını kurtardığı belirtildi.
items.body_text:
Güncelleme Tarihi:
DHA
Oluşturulma Tarihi: Ekim 10, 2026 15:21
Haberin Devamı
Olay, 6 Ekim saat 15.00 sıralarında Arsin ilçesi Yeşilce Mahallesi’nde meydana geldi. 20 gün önce boşanan Aydın Yediparmak ile Gülşah Oktay, buluştukları araçta bilinmeyen nedenle tartışmaya başladı. Tartışmanın büyümesiyle Aydın Yediparmak, yanındaki tabancayla Gülşah Oktay’a ateş etti. Yediparmak kaçarken, vücudunun çeşitli yerlerine 7 kurşun isabet eden Oktay yaralandı. İhbar üzerine olay yerine polis ve sağlık ekipleri sevk edildi. Ekipler tarafından ilk müdahalesi yapılan Oktay, Kanuni Eğitim ve Araştırma Hastanesi’ne kaldırılarak ameliyata alındı. Gülşah Oktay, tedavi gördüğü hastanede hayatını kaybetti. Polis ekiplerinin çalışmasıyla yakalanan şüpheli gözaltına alındı.
14 GÜN ÖNCE İNTİHARA KALKIŞMIŞ
Maddi sıkıntılar çektiği için 14 gün önce intihara girişiminde bulunan Aydın Yediparmak'ı, eski eşi Gülşah Oktay'ın kurtardığı ortaya çıktı. Evinde 4 tablet ilaç içip fenalaşan Yediparmak'ın yanına giden Oktay'ın, çöp kutusunda boş ilaç kutularını fark etmesi üzerine sağlık ekiplerinden yardım istediği öğrenildi. Evinde fenalaşan Yediparmak, kaldırıldığı hastanede tedaviye alındı. Yediparmak'ın o gün polise verdiği ifadede, baygın olduğu için telefonu ve kapı zilini duymadığını anlattığı ve kimseden şikayetçi olmadığını ifade ettiği bildirildi.
CİNAYETİ İTİRAF ETTİ
Hakkında 4 ayrı suç kaydı bulunduğu iddia edilen Aydın Yediparmak, emniyetteki sorgusunda cinayeti itiraf etti.
Borcu olduğunu belirten Yediparmak, "Eşimin üzerinde taşınmaz olduğu için icradan kurtulmak amacıyla anlaşmalı boşandık. Boşandıktan sonra Gülşah annesiyle yaşıyordu. Maddi sıkıntılar nedeniyle aramızda tartışmalar çıkıyordu, bana verdiği borç parayı geri istiyordu. Olay günü yeni doğan çocuğumuzun mamasının bittiğini söyledi ve kimlik işlemleri için buluştuk. Giderken gül alıp koltuğun üstüne koydum. İşlemleri hallettik ve evimin önüne geldik. Şarjım bittiği için şarj aletini evden aldım. Gülşah bana verdiği borcu sordu, ardından bana 'hırsız' deyip ailemi suçladı. Bunu gururuma yediremedim. Ben de silahımı çekerek ateşledim. Silaha engel olmaya çalıştı, araçtan inip ayağını tutarak yürüyordu. Kendisine yetiştim ve silahı tekrar ateşledim. Yere düşünce silahı bıraktım ve eve çıktım. Olay anlık gelişti, pişmanım" ifadelerini kullandı.
Emniyetteki işlemlerinin ardından adliyeye sevk edilen Aydın Yediparmak, çıkarıldığı Nöbetçi Sulh Ceza Hakimliği tarafından 'Kasten öldürme' suçundan tutuklanarak cezaevine gönderildi.

items.title: Sweden regrets US-Russia diesel agreement
items.summary: 'We regret the US agreement with Russia to supply diesel, as energy revenues are a vital source of funding Russia’s war of aggression,' premier says
items.body_text:
Ilayda Cakirtekin
10 October 2026•Update: 10 October 2026
Swedish Prime Minister Ulf Kristersson voiced regret Saturday over a recently announced diesel deal between US President Donald Trump and Russian President Vladimir Putin.
"We regret the US agreement with Russia to supply diesel, as energy revenues are a vital source of funding Russia’s war of aggression," Kristersson wrote on US social media platform X.
He reiterated Sweden's ongoing position to stand with Ukraine "for as long as it takes," and called for more pressure to be put on Russia and more support to be provided to Ukraine.
"On Monday, the EU will adopt the largest sanctions package to date, listing 1,600 entities in the Russian military industrial complex. This is - in contrast - a welcome step," Kristersson added.
He further called on countries to do more against the shadow fleet and make use of the frozen Russian assets.
"In all of this, we need to stay closely coordinated in the EU and with the US, UK and other international partners. The broad political and popular support in Sweden for Ukraine is a strength and an asset in these turbulent times," he added.
Putin and Trump spoke over the phone on Friday. Trump described the conversation as a “highly successful discussion.”
In a post on his Truth Social platform, Trump said the talks resulted in an agreement for Russia to “immediately supply” more than 300,000 tons of diesel fuel to US and global markets.
He said another 500,000 tons would be supplied in November, followed by 1 million tons and an additional 3 million tons “within a short period,” depending on the condition of Russian diesel refineries.
Putin said Russian diesel supplies to US and global markets would benefit the world economy, adding that the two leaders discussed the global energy sector, prospects for resolving the Ukraine war, the situation in Iran, and bilateral relations.
items.normalised_title: sweden regrets us

items.title: Latvia thanks Türkiye for contribution to airspace protection
items.summary: 'I thank Türkiye for its responsiveness and operational action, providing a significant contribution to strengthening the security of Latvian airspace,' defense minister says
items.body_text:
Ilayda Cakirtekin
10 October 2026•Update: 10 October 2026
Latvian Defense Minister Raivis Melnis thanked Türkiye on Friday for its contribution to strengthening the defense of the country's airspace.
"I thank Türkiye for its responsiveness and operational action, providing a significant contribution to strengthening the security of Latvian airspace," Melnis said in a statement issued by the Defense Ministry.
The statement came after Melnis met with a Turkish Air Force unit at the National Armed Forces military base in Lielvarde.
"The presence of Turkish fighter jets in Lielvarde demonstrates NATO's ability to respond quickly and effectively move forces where they are needed," he said.
Melnis further stressed the need for close cooperation between allies, mutual trust, and readiness to act together for the security of Latvia and the entire eastern flank of NATO.
The statement noted that Turkish Air Force F-16 fighters were temporarily stationed in Latvia to support NATO Integrated Air and Missile Defense activities.
It said the deployment of Turkish fighter jets allowed for testing NATO's ability to quickly move and deploy allied forces and the readiness of Latvia's military base to receive and support allied air forces.

items.title: Czechia awaits results of polls for municipal, Senate elections
items.summary: Initial results expected late Saturday
items.body_text:
Ilayda Cakirtekin
10 October 2026•Update: 10 October 2026
Polls closed on Saturday in the Czech Republic, where voters cast ballots in municipal elections and elections for one-third of the seats in the Senate, according to Radio Prague.
Nearly 190,000 candidates competed for around 62,000 seats on local councils, while 154 candidates contested 27 seats in the upper house of parliament.
Initial results are expected late Saturday, with complete results due early Sunday.
A second round of Senate elections is scheduled for next weekend.

items.title: Turkey's Green Taxonomy paradox ahead of COP31: ‘Nuclear energy and fossil gas are unacceptable’
items.summary: Turkey's Green Taxonomy Regulation came into force ahead of COP31. The inclusion of nuclear energy, fossil gas, and carbon-intensive manufacturing sectors in the Taxonomy drew criticism. Experts assessed the regulation for bianet.
items.body_text:
The Regulation on the Green Taxonomy of Turkey, prepared by the Directorate of Climate Change under the Environment, Urbanization and Climate Change Ministry, entered into force after being published in the Official Gazette on Sep 24.
Although the regulation excludes solid fossil fuels, its annexes include activities such as generating electricity and providing district heating and cooling from fossil gas. New nuclear power plant construction is also included in the taxonomy. In addition, plastics and greenhouse gas intensive iron and steel manufacturing have taken their place in the regulation.
The inclusion of fossil gas and nuclear energy among sustainable activities in the green regulation of Turkey, which will host the 31st United Nations Climate Change Conference (COP31), has drawn criticism.
Prof. Dr. Murat Türkeş from the Boğaziçi University Center for Climate Change and Policy Studies, Ümit Şahin, senior scholar and Climate Change Studies Coordinator at the İstanbul Policy Center, and Ömür Yaşayan, head of the İstanbul Branch of the Chamber of Environmental Engineers (ÇMO), assessed the regulation for bianet.
What is Green Taxonomy?
The Green Taxonomy is a classification system designed to support activities aligned with the net-zero emissions target and the vision for green growth.
Prof. Türkeş explains the regulation:
Turkey was working on the taxonomy within the scope of alignment with EU climate change standards and policies and the Green Deal. The Green Taxonomy is a scientific and technical classification that prevents greenwashing by establishing which economic activities and investments are environmentally sustainable and truly green.
The regulation has six objectives:
- Mitigation of greenhouse gas emissions,
- Climate change adaptation,
- Sustainable use and protection of water and marine resources,
- Transition to a circular economy,
- Pollution prevention and control,
- Protection and restoration of biodiversity and ecosystems.
'Including nuclear energy in the taxonomy is unacceptable'
Another topic drawing backlash is the inclusion of nuclear energy in the regulation. The construction and operation of new nuclear power plants were classified as a transition activity. Electricity generation from nuclear energy in existing facilities is also included under this definition.
Ümit Şahin, the climate scientist, stressed that showing nuclear energy within the Green Taxonomy, even as a transition activity, is unacceptable, calling it "completely illogical":
A nuclear plant with a 60 year lifespan... Construction of nuclear plants is also included in the Green Taxonomy. Here, plant construction was added as ‘green and transitional.’ How can a nuclear energy facility that will produce electricity for 60 years be considered a transition? That is already completely illogical. A facility that cannot be shut down for 60 years once built cannot be a transition. Transitioning from where to where? It is completely illogical. An energy source that pollutes the environment so severely and poses health and accident risks like nuclear energy can never be evaluated within a Green Taxonomy. It does not meet any of the six criteria they set themselves. I think it is a huge mistake.
ÇMO İstanbul Branch Chair Ömür Yaşayan noted that opening green finance to gas plants operating for 30 to 40 years, alongside Rosatom’s Akkuyu project and upcoming projects in Sinop and Thrace, reduces the 2053 net-zero target to mere rhetoric:
It carries the risk of locking the country into fossil fuels and radioactive waste issues for decades.
Noting that considering natural gas and nuclear “green” is also received very negatively worldwide, Prof. Dr. Türkeş said:
Nuclear energy has many problems, including accidents, waste disposal, waste management, and external dependency. When you look at it from the perspective of energy security, there is a high dependency on developed countries. Natural gas, on the other hand, is a fossil fuel. In addition to

items.title: Daughter sentenced to aggravated life imprisonment for killing singer Güllü
items.summary: Tuğyan Ülkem Gülter insisted the incident was an acident.
items.body_text:
A court has sentenced Tuğyan Ülkem Gülter to aggravated life imprisonment for killing her mother, singer Gül Tut, known professionally as Güllü, who died after falling from a sixth-floor window last year.
The verdict was delivered at the second hearing of the trial at the Yalova 1st Heavy Penal Court. Gülter, who had been held in pretrial detention on charges of premeditated murder of a parent, denied the accusations throughout the proceedings.
Güllü died on Sep 26, 2025, after falling from her apartment window in the Çınarcık district of Yalova, northwestern Turkey. The court determined that she was pushed by Gülter.
The investigation led to the detention of Gülter and her friend Sultan Nur Ulu, who was also present in the apartment at the time of the incident. Gülter was subsequently arrested, while Ulu was initially placed under house arrest. Prosecutors charged Ulu with giving false testimony, seeking a prison sentence of two to four years.
Conflicting accounts
During today's hearing, Gülter, 28, said she had been dancing and singing with her mother and Ulu shortly before the fall.
"Then there was a sound. When I turned around, my mother was gone. Then I shouted to Sultan, 'Run.' We went downstairs together," she told the court.
Gülter denied pushing her mother, insisting that her back had been turned at the time.
Ulu, however, testified at the previous hearing that she had witnessed Gülter throw her mother from the window. She also alleged that Gülter threatened her at Güllü's funeral, saying, "If you expose me, I'll expose you too."
Ulu said she initially gave a different account because she was in shock.
Defense challenges evidence
The trial also examined security recordings from cameras inside the apartment containing the phrase "See you later," heard around the time of the fall.
Gülter's lawyer, Merve Uçanok, argued that the voice belonged to Güllü and presented a video of the singer using the same phrase.
Uçanok also raised the possibility of an accidental fall, citing photographs of objects near the window and an initial autopsy report describing a slippery surface.
She questioned whether Güllü could have been thrown from the window without resisting and argued that Gülter would not have committed the act in front of a witness while knowing cameras were present.
In her final statement, Gülter again denied the allegations and accused witnesses of making false statements.
"I do not accept the accusations against me. I never saw the moment my mother fell," she said. "No matter what sentence you give me, I know I am innocent.
After a recess, the court announced its verdict, sentencing Gülter to aggravated life imprisonment.
About Güllü
A person of Roma decent, Gül Tut was born on Oct 15, 1973, in the Kasımpaşa neighborhood of İstanbul’s Beyoğlu district.
She began singing in nightclubs at an early age and started performing at wedding venues when she was 15. Nightclub owners were reluctant to hire her because of her age, forcing her to return to school for a time. She eventually dropped out due to financial difficulties and pursued her music career.
She rose to fame in the 1990s under the stage name "Kasımpaşalı Güllü" (Güllü of Kasımpaşa), gaining recognition for her performances of Roma music and arabesque-pop songs. Her albums and personal life frequently attracted media attention, and she became one of the most popular singers of the era.
Güllü took a break from performing for a period during her marriage. She had two children and resumed her music career after divorcing in 2000. In 2008, she was hospitalized with alcohol poisoning in Kartal's Yakacık neighborhood and recovered after receiving treatment.
In 2021, Güllü attended the QueerFest event in Ankara, where she unfurled a transgender pride flag.
Throughout her career, Güllü released numerous hit songs, including "Kasımpaşalıyım," "Gülüm Var," "Oyuncak Gibi," "Değmezmiş Sana," "Balıkesir Bandırma" and "Benim Vicdanım Rahat."

items.title: Probe into investment fund scandal reveals 214 people and firms made over 3.7 billion dollars in profits
items.summary: Authorities are notifying those who made large profits to return the money, said the justice minister.
items.body_text:
A total of 214 individuals and companies made 187.65 billion liras, or more than 3.7 billion US dollars in profits from three investment fund groups at the center of a market manipulation investigation in Turkey, according to findings announced by Justice Minister Akın Gürlek.
The investigation led by the İstanbul Chief Public Prosecutor's Office identified 141 individuals and 73 companies that each made more than 100 million liras from funds managed by Tera, Pusula and Hedef Portföy.
The individuals collectively earned 100.68 billion liras, while the companies recorded profits of 86.98 billion liras, according to the investigation findings (1 US dollar = 49.34 Turkish lira).
More than 500,000 people had invested in the funds affected by the crisis.
Gürlek told Sabah newspaper today that prosecutors had forwarded the identities of those who profited from the funds to the Savings Deposit Insurance Fund (TMSF).
The TMSF has begun formally notifying those on the list to return the money. Recovered funds will be held in accounts established to compensate affected investors.
Inside knowledge
Gürlek said investigators were focusing particularly on investors who sold their fund holdings and withdrew their money between Sep 13 and Sep 16, just before the crisis began.
According to the minister, investigators determined that these investors had exited the funds after receiving advance information about the situation. He said the investigation had been expanded to examine those transactions.
Treasury and Finance Minister Mehmet Şimşek separately announced that 17 funds available through the Turkish Electronic Fund Trading Platform (TEFAS) had been liquidated, with money belonging to 43,000 investors transferred to the relevant banks.
Investment fund crisis: AKP deputy chair resigns after substantial gains alleged as dozens jailed
Investigators found that 102 individuals made approximately 28 billion liras from Tera funds, while 38 companies earned about 62.08 billion liras.
Pusula funds generated approximately 69.7 billion liras in profits for 19 individuals and another 10 billion liras for 20 companies.
In Hedef Portföy funds, 20 individuals made about 2.98 billion liras, while 15 companies earned approximately 14.9 billion liras.
Background
The crisis began on Sep 17, when investment funds holding large positions in stocks with limited freely tradable shares struggled to meet investors' redemption requests.
The Capital Markets Board (SPK) subsequently suspended trading through TEFAS for funds managed by seven portfolio management companies and ordered the liquidation of 131 funds.
The regulator said funds managed by some portfolio companies had contributed to price movements in low-float stocks that could not be explained by the companies' financial performance or economic circumstances.
Turkey’s investment fund crisis in 10 questions: Phantom returns and a market meltdown
Authorities ordered the liquidation of funds with a combined volume of approximately 18.3 billion US dollars.
The SPK had already tightened regulations on Aug 28, introducing stricter requirements covering portfolio concentration, related-party transactions, valuation methods and hedge fund operations.
Under Article 107 of Turkey's Capital Markets Law, transactions intended to create false or misleading impressions about the price, price movements, supply or demand of financial instruments can constitute market fraud. (VK)

items.summary: DAEGU, Oct. 10 (Yonhap) -- Large sections of ceiling finish material collapsed i...
items.body_text:
(LEAD) Ceiling material collapses in Daegu building, injures 38
(ATTN: ADDS details in last 2 paras)
DAEGU, Oct. 10 (Yonhap) -- Large sections of ceiling finish material collapsed in a building in Daegu on Saturday, injuring 38 people, including nine who were taken to hospitals, officials said.
A kitchenware sales event for senior citizens was being held on the second floor of a four-story building in the southeastern city when the material fell from the ceiling at 10:16 a.m., according to Daegu firefighting and local district officials.
Sixty-six people fled the building, and of them, 38 sustained light injuries, such as abrasions, the officials said. Nine of the injured were transferred to hospitals, but no one was in critical condition.
Firefighters sent 60 personnel and used 14 pieces of equipment to search the premise for additional casualties, but none were found.
President Lee Jae Myung was briefed on the accident by the acting police chief and ordered relevant agencies to do everything to rescue any victims and handle the aftermath, according to his office.
Authorities said they plan to investigate the cause of the collapse.
The Daegu Metropolitan Policy Agency said it has formed a dedicated task force to investigate the accident. The team, consisting of some 33 personnel including officials from the serious accidents, forensic science and victims protection units, plans to conduct a joint on-site investigation Monday with the National Forensic Science and other related agencies.
 "We will look into potential structural defects and whether safety measures were properly implemented," a police official said.

items.title: KBO's Eagles decide not to re-sign manager Kim Kyung-moon
items.summary: SEOUL, Oct. 10 (Yonhap) -- The Hanwha Eagles announced Saturday they will not br...
items.body_text:
KBO's Eagles decide not to re-sign manager Kim Kyung-moon
By Yoo Jee-ho
SEOUL, Oct. 10 (Yonhap) -- The Hanwha Eagles announced Saturday they will not bring back manager Kim Kyung-moon after his three-year contract expires at the end of this season.
Kim first took over the Eagles in June 2024. Last year, he guided the Eagles to their first Korean Series since 2006, but they lost to the LG Twins in five games.
This year, the Eagles had long clinched ninth place in the 10-team Korea Baseball Organization (KBO) prior to their final regular-season game Saturday, with a win-loss-tie record of 57-82-4.
 The Eagles said they are looking to hire a new manager with Kim's contract expiring, and they also thanked the veteran skipper for his services.
Kim himself announced he will not be back next year during his pregame media availability Saturday.
"This will be my last game here. I am really sorry to our fans that we have lost so many games," Kim told reporters at Daejeon Hanwha Life Ballpark in Daejeon, some 140 kilometers south of Seoul. "I feel bad that I am leaving without having made the team better. I would like to thank all the players, coaches and front office staff that have been with me on this journey."
At 67, Kim has been the oldest manager in the KBO this year. He has yet to win a Korean Series title in over 20 years as manager -- the 2025 runner-up finish being his fifth.
He is one of three managers in league history with over 1,000 regular-season wins. He came into Saturday's game with 1,078 wins, 957 losses and 39 ties.
In 2025, the Eagles nearly won the pennant and posted the second-best record in the regular season at 83-57-4. Their two American aces, Cody Ponce and Ryan Weiss, formed a deadly one-two punch atop the rotation, combining for 33 wins and 459 strikeouts in 359 1/3 innings. Ponce was voted the league MVP after winning the pitching Triple Crown as the league leader in wins, ERA and strikeouts. He and Weiss, with 252 strikeouts and 207 strikeouts, respectively, became the first pair of teammates to record at least 200 Ks in the same season.
However, both of them left for Major League Baseball this year, and their two replacements, Owen White and Wilkel Hernandez, never filled that void. After Hernandez was cut in July, his replacement, Bruce Zimmermann, also struggled mightily in the rotation before moving to the bullpen.
The Eagles' offense this year has been better than 2025, as they are tops in the KBO with 175 home runs and 813 runs scored. Their big free agent acquisition Kang Baek-ho has led the way with his career-high 34 dingers.
But they have the KBO's second-worst ERA at 5.27, compared with their league-best mark of 3.55 in 2025.

(END)

items.title: Today in Korean history
items.summary: Oct. 11
items.body_text:
Today in Korean history
Oct. 11
1989 -- The state-run Korea Aerospace Research Institute is launched.
1996 -- South Korea joins the Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development as its 29th member state.
2000 -- U.S. Secretary of State Madeleine Albright meets Cho Myong-rok, vice chairman of North Korea's National Defense Commission, during her visit to Pyongyang.
2003 -- Prime Minister Goh Kun and other Cabinet members offer to resign en masse following the National Assembly's impeachment of President Roh Moo-hyun on charges of illegal electioneering.
2011 -- South Korean President Lee Myung-bak leaves for Washington for talks with U.S. President Barack Obama as Congress is set to endorse a long-pending free trade agreement with Seoul.
2013 -- State prosecutors raid the headquarters of Hyosung Group in a probe into allegations the country's 26th-largest conglomerate evaded a massive amount of taxes.
2014 -- The North Korean delegation to the Asian Para Games arrives in the South Korean host city of Incheon, days after the two Koreas exchanged machine gun fire across the border.
 2015 -- The United States wins the Presidents Cup for the ninth time, defeating the International Team 15 1/2 to 14 1/2 after a nail-biting finish in South Korea's Incheon. This was the first Presidents Cup to take place in Asia.
(END)

items.title: 홍준표 “TK 몰락 가슴 아파…비난 각오하고 김부겸 밀었지만, 진심 안 통해”
items.body_text:
홍준표 전 대구시장이 지난 6·3 지방선거에서 김부겸 더불어민주당 대구시장 후보를 지지했던 것과 관련해 “대구 시민들은 내 진심을 받아주지 않았다”고 말했다.
홍 전 시장은 10일 자신의 페이스북 계정에 “TK(대구·경북) 몰락이 참 가슴 아프다”며 “대구시장 3년을 하면서 TK 미래 100년 사업을 100가지와 플러스1로 선정하고, 그중 재임 중 75% 정도를 착수하거나 완성했는데 가장 핵심적인 TK신공항 사업은 착공조차 하지 못했다”고 적었다.
이어 그는 “아무리 몸부림쳐도 중앙정부의 도움이 없어 대구시장 힘만으로는 되지 않았다”며 “그래서 지난번 지방선거 때 TK 미래 핵심사업들 완성을 위해 비난을 각오하고 김부겸을 밀었으나 대구 시민들은 내 진심을 받아주지 않았다”고 썼다.
홍 전 시장은 지난 지방선거에서 김부겸 더불어민주당 후보를 공개 지지했다. TK신공항 건설 등 자신이 추진한 사업을 완성하려면 중앙정부의 지원이 필요하다는 이유였다. 그러나 선거에서는 현 대구시장인 추경호 국민의힘 후보가 53.92%를 득표해 45.05%를 얻은 김 후보를 꺾고 당선됐다.
홍 전 시장은 “각종 국책사업에도 소외되고 신공항은 허공에 떠버리고 30년 GDP 꼴찌는 일상화됐다”며 “3년 동안 외부 인사, 토호들과 오·만찬 한 번 없이 오로지 TK 도약을 위해 밤낮없이 분투했지만 시도민들은 그걸 받아주지 않았다”고 했다.
또 그는 “지역감정에 갇혀 사는 세월이 얼마나 허망한 시간이었는지 더 당해봐야 알게 될는지”라며 “섭섭한 마음 가눌 길 없지만 그런 생각은 가을 하늘에 훌훌 날려 보내기로 했다”고 했다.
그러면서 “그래도 다시 한번 TK 도약을 위해 시도민들이 힘을 모았으면 한다”며 “지역감정도 버리고 당도 버리고 오로지 대구·경북의 미래만을 위한 열정에 매진했으면 한다”고 덧붙였다.

items.title: 일요일 낮 최고 28도, 일교차 ‘최대 15도’…전국 내륙 중심 소나기
items.body_text:
광고
한글날 연휴 마지막 날인 11일 일요일은 낮 기온이 최고 28도까지 오르는 등 포근한 날씨가 이어질 전망이다. 다만 내륙 곳곳에 소나기가 내리고 아침과 낮의 기온 차이도 커 외출할 때는 우산과 가벼운 겉옷을 챙기는 등 대비가 필요하다.
10일 기상청은 “내일 아침최저기온은 10~20℃, 낮최고기온은 22~28℃가 되겠다”며 “전국 내륙을 중심으로 낮과 밤의 기온차가 10~15℃ 안팎으로 크겠으니, 건강관리에 유의해야 한다”고 밝혔다.
지역별 아침 최저기온은 서울 15도, 인천 16도, 수원 15도, 춘천 11도, 강릉 15도, 청주 15도, 대전 13도, 전주 16도, 광주 15도, 대구 16도, 부산 20도, 울산 17도 등이다.
광고
낮 최고기온은 서울·인천·수원·부산·울산·제주 26도, 춘천 25도, 강릉 23도, 청주·대전·전주·광주 27도, 대구 28도까지 오를 것으로 보인다.
낮 12시부터 밤 9시 사이에는 전국 내륙 곳곳에 소나기가 예고됐다. 경기 남부 내륙과 강원 남부 내륙·산지, 대전·세종·충남 내륙, 충북의 예상 강수량은 5~20㎜다. 전북·전남 동부와 대구·경북 내륙 및 북동 산지, 경남 서부 내륙에는 5~10㎜의 소나기가 내리겠다. 제주도에서는 11일부터 이틀간 5~40㎜의 비가 예상된다.
광고
광고
미세먼지 농도는 전국에서 ‘좋음’ 또는 ‘보통’ 수준을 보이겠다.
